paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different stimulus material types used by journalists in conversations with large language models. The chart features ten categories, visually arranged in descending order of size. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents "Draft/Other" at 26.4%. Following this is a segment labeled "Press Release" in green, accounting for 18.7% of the total. "External News Article" is shown in dark blue at 18.1% while "Interview" is represented by a purple segment with 8.8%. Further categories include "Organizational Report" (7.7%, light blue), "Event Posting" (6.6%, violet), “Organizational Website” (4.9%, light green), "Intra-agency news" (4.9%, dark green), "Email" (2.7%, teal), and “Stimulus” (1.1%, pink). The chart includes a legend providing the label and corresponding percentage for each segment; no slices are exploded or visually emphasized beyond their relative size.
